descriptors.definition: A company is treated as a distinct person for assessment purposes under the tax statute, encompassing Indian companies, foreign bodies corporate, and specified notified institutions. The statutory tax framework differentiates between domestic and foreign entities, applying distinct tax rates and surcharges based on turnover thresholds and company status.
inclusion: Institutions declared as companies by CBDT order
exclusion: Non-corporate entities like sole proprietorships unless declared
nearby_distinctions: Distinction between domestic companies taxed at tiered rates versus foreign companies subject to standard foreign tax rates

descriptors.concept_name: Alternate Minimum Tax for Non-Corporate Entities
descriptors.definition: Alternate Minimum Tax mandates non-corporate taxpayers claiming specified deductions to pay a baseline tax percentage if their regular tax liability falls below the computed alternate minimum threshold on adjusted total income. Adjusted total income is derived by adding back specified Chapter VIII-C deductions and investment-linked deductions to the regular total income.
inclusion: Non-corporate taxpayers claiming deductions under Chapter VIII-C or section 46
exclusion: Assessees whose adjusted total income does not exceed twenty lakh rupees
nearby_distinctions: Differs from regular corporate minimum tax mechanisms by applying specifically to non-corporate entities based on adjusted total income benchmarks

descriptors.concept_name: Liability of Successor to Business in Respect of Tax Chargeable from Predecessor
descriptors.definition: When a business or profession is transferred, the predecessor and successor are independently assessed for the income earned during their respective operational periods within that tax year. If the predecessor cannot be located, the successor inherits the tax liability for the succession year and the preceding year.
inclusion: Apportionment of income between predecessor and successor for the succession year
Transfer of assessment proceedings pending before courts or tribunals
exclusion: Liabilities unrelated to the transferred business operations prior to succession
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between ongoing separate assessments during normal succession versus unified successor liability when the predecessor is untraceable

descriptors.concept_name: Tax Planning Considerations in Relation to Business Structures
descriptors.definition: Tax planning for business enterprises involves evaluating structural, financial, and operational choices at inception to optimize liability under business income provisions. Selecting the appropriate organizational form is critical because subsequent structural conversions may trigger unintended tax liabilities.
terminology: Profits and gains of business or profession
inclusion: Initial selection of business legal form
Planning around accounting methods and asset acquisition
exclusion: Post-commencement structural changes without prior tax impact analysis
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes structural establishment planning from routine operational tax compliance and filing

descriptors.concept_name: Taxation of Income from Global Depository Receipts for Resident Employees
descriptors.definition: Resident employees of specified knowledge-based Indian companies or their subsidiaries are taxed at concessional rates on dividends and long-term capital gains derived from foreign currency Global Depository Receipts. Gross total income calculations exclude standard deductions against such specific foreign currency depository receipt incomes.
inclusion: Resident employee dividend income from specified GDRs
Long-term capital gains from GDR transfers
exclusion: Deductions under general provisions when gross total income consists solely of GDR dividend income
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes specialized concessional taxation of employee stock-option-linked GDRs from standard capital gains and dividend tax regimes
